test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a circle, the length of a chord is 30 cm. The perpendicular distance of the chord from the centre of the circle is 8 cm. Find the diameter of the circle.
solution:
Given:

Length of a chord is 30 cm

Chord is 8 cm away from the centre of the circle

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66fbecb9a083533887fa355e6889e466090c981178dd8426d77b8dde1f2026e5.png] 

Let AB be the chord and O be the center of the circle.

Also, OP is perpendicular to AB

In Δ OPB,

OB2 = PB2 + OP2

OB2 = 152 + 82

OB2 = 225 + 64

OB2 = 289

OB = √289 

OB = 17

Diameter = 2 × OB = 2 × 17 = 34

∴ The diameter of the circle is 34 cm.
